description: This file defines the 'Location' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a location with various attributes such as name, address, contact details, and relationships to other entities like Country and Employee. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying its properties.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Entity class representing a geographical or operational location within the HRM system, with properties for location details and associations to country and employees.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the location.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the location.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the location.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the location.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the associated Country object.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the associated Country object.

methods.name: getProvince
methods.description: Returns the province/state of the location, if set.

methods.name: setProvince
methods.description: Sets the province/state of the location.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city of the location, if set.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the city of the location.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address details of the location.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the address details of the location.

methods.name: getZipCode
methods.description: Returns the ZIP code of the location.

methods.name: setZipCode
methods.description: Sets the ZIP code of the location.

methods.name: getPhone
methods.description: Returns the phone number associated with the location.

methods.name: setPhone
methods.description: Sets the phone number for the location.

methods.name: getFax
methods.description: Returns the fax number for the location.

methods.name: setFax
methods.description: Sets the fax number for the location.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns additional notes related to the location.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets additional notes for the location.
